evidence_boundary: Engineering sensitivity model; not a fabricated-device or transistor-layout comparison.

half_effective_ionic_distance_screen.caution: This is a sensitivity bracket, not a compact physical model. Filament nucleation barriers can dominate.

preferred_target.minimum_device_gate: p95 <= 38 ns against the hardest v14M energy-delay reference
preferred_target.reason: At about 12.5 ns mean junction delay, the sparse 64-hop transport proxy reaches ~111.5 ns, approximately equal to the favorable CMOS latency control; 10 ns reaches ~99.1 ns.

decision: Keep Seeded Nucleation BDJ plus Sparse Regeneration Trunk. The seed attacks ionic nucleation delay; sparse regeneration removes unnecessary active switching on physical transport hops. Semantic reasoning nodes are never skipped.
